messages:
emma-c: Alert from support: several tenants experienced SSO failures and cascading SCIM deprovisions right after the RBAC enforcement rollout. Logs show SAML binding mismatches and a small window where audit events didn't arrive.

emma-c: Key log snippets:
```
ERROR auth-proxy: saml: binding mismatch expected=HTTP-POST got=HTTP-Artifact tenant=varuna
WARN scim-worker: deprov enqueue tenant=varuna svc_acc=sa-reports cause=auth_failed
ERROR audit-shipper: flush failed reason=shutdown_in_progress ts=1759011005
```

raj-p: My quick take: two concurrent problems. (1) Some IdPs updated metadata to HTTP-Artifact only — our SP was set to POST-only in the RBAC change. (2) audit-shipper restarted during a key rotation and missed flushing a handful of events. Both together made it look like auth->role change -> deprov.

raj-p: Quick checks to run:
```
# check local SP metadata
curl -s https://auth-proxy.internal/.well-known/saml-metadata | xmllint --xpath "//Binding/text()" -
# check audit-shipper restart time
kubectl logs -n infra deploy/audit-shipper --since=1h | grep "shutdown_in_progress"
```

kevin-m: Pulled tenant metadata for varuna — they advertise HTTP-Artifact only. We tightened validation during the rollout to deny artifact; that explains immediate assertion rejects.

emma-c: Mitigation plan: (A) Add a tenant-scoped artifact fallback toggle in auth-proxy and enable for affected tenants, (B) requeue SCIM deprovs for impacted tenants after auth passes, (C) backfill missing audit events from shipper buffer if available, (D) run a KMS/token-store alias sanity to ensure no wrapped-token unwrap failures.

kevin-m: I'll open a tiny PR to add saml.allow_artifact_fallback with a tenant whitelist and canary to infra-canary. Low-risk toggle, default off.

raj-p: I'll check token-store and KMS alias history in case any tokens couldn't be unwrapped during rotation. Commands: `redis-cli HGET token:wrap:<tenant> current_alias` and check KMS audit log for alias rekey times.

oncall: Incident INC-175901 opened. I'm running requeue & backfill now:
```
./scripts/requeue-deprov.sh --tenant varuna --since 1759010800
./scripts/backfill-audit.sh --start 1759010700 --end 1759011300 --verify
```

audit-bot: audit-shipper restarted at 1759011005 due to deployment; 42 events were buffered and 0 persisted during that interval. Backfill helper started.

emma-c: Owners: Kevin=auth-proxy toggle + canary, Raj=KMS/token-store check, Emma=backfill & requeue verification, Oncall=customer comms + incident timeline. After mitigations complete we'll run a postmortem and add a preflight that validates per-tenant SAML bindings before RBAC changes. Ping here with results. :thumbsup:
